_meta.title: CONCORD-500 v3.0 ENRICHED — architecture/spec (3-layer enrichment)
_meta.status: METACOD-RF — Research Framework, not clinical guidance
_meta.author: Mark Litvak — CONCORD-500 v3.0 (dedication: посвящается Анне)
_meta.scope_note: This artifact records the v3.0 ENRICHED ARCHITECTURE/SPEC as described by Mark (layers, distributions, deployment, capabilities, honest boundaries). It is NOT the data itself.

data_files_not_in_repo.master_bundle_v3.0_enriched.json: ~3.0 MB — full enriched bundle (1778 records: 350 diseases + 658 drugs + 450 symptoms + 320 labs). NOT pasted/materialized.
data_files_not_in_repo.concord500_v3_enrichment.sql: ~1.8 MB — additive schema (5 enrichment tables + 2368 INSERTs). NOT pasted/materialized.
data_files_not_in_repo.action: When Mark provides the actual files, materialize under the governance gates below (and apply the Hamer reconciliation decision first).

governance_safety_annotation.research_only: [GOVERNANCE] ready_for_clinical_use=false. Enrichment is a navigation/approximation layer, NOT clinical guidance.
governance_safety_annotation.rule_derived_not_curated: [Mark's own 'честные границы'] The METACOD enrichment layer is RULE-DERIVED by category/class/energetics, NOT hand-curated expert annotation. A structural approximation; priority cases need manual review.
governance_safety_annotation.graph_statistical_not_causal: [Mark] Graph edges are STATISTICAL (symptom/lab overlap), NOT causal. Comorbidity/progression are separate curated fields, currently minimal (await validation).
governance_safety_annotation.clinical_fields_templated: [Mark] Clinical fields are category-TEMPLATED; exact figures (epidemiology, specific PK) need sourcing.
governance_safety_annotation.not_operationalized: No part of v3.0 is wired into the engine. The SQL capability examples (Revici balancing, DDI screen, similar-disease graph, Hamer-phase navigation) are illustrative, not deployed.

CRITICAL_GOVERNANCE_FLAG.hamer_conflict_theme_vs_kcts_v1_1: [FLAG-FOR-MARK — CRITICAL, BLOCKS MATERIALIZATION] The v3.0 METACOD layer reintroduces a Hamer-phase enrichment WITH a 'тема конфликта' (conflict theme) field (conflict-active / PCL-A / PCL-B / hanging-healing). The 'conflict theme' is precisely the Hamer/GNM/AIRE PSYCHIC-CONFLICT CAUSALITY that the KCTS v1.1 decision (Mark, 2026-06) DISAVOWED as mechanism. This is a direct contradiction with the established governance line and must be reconciled by Mark BEFORE the v3.0 data is materialized. See reconciliation_options.

reconciliation_options.A_phase_taxonomy_only: Keep Hamer-phase as a PURE PHASE-TAXONOMY descriptor (CA/PCL-A/PCL-B/PCL-Final mapped onto the 5-phase axis) and DROP the 'conflict theme' causal field. Consistent with KCTS v1.1. [Default-safe — recommended unless Mark says otherwise.]
reconciliation_options.B_reinstate_conflict_causality: v3.0 intends to RE-INSTATE Hamer psychic-conflict causality → this REVERSES the KCTS v1.1 EBM decision (major governance change; would need explicit Mark sign-off and re-opening kcts_integration v1.1).
reconciliation_options.C_quarantine: Keep 'conflict theme' but quarantined as disclosed-origin-only metadata, flagged, never operationalized and never surfaced — same treatment as the disavowed KCTS origin.

_meta.kcts_v1_1_alignment: [KCTS v1.1] Hamer/AIRE psychic-conflict causality DISAVOWED as mechanism. The v3.0 'conflict theme' field is in tension with this — see CRITICAL_GOVERNANCE_FLAG.

drugs: DDI flags (CYP, QT, serotonergic, nephrotoxic, bleeding)

layer_2_metacod.hamer_phase: conflict-active / PCL-A / PCL-B / hanging-healing + conflict theme  [conflict-theme FLAGGED vs KCTS v1.1]
layer_2_metacod.energy_opposition: which energy opposes the pattern (therapeutic vector)

engine_capabilities_illustrative.revici_balancing: catabolic disease → anabolic-agent drug (opposite metabolic vector)
engine_capabilities_illustrative.ddi_screen: find all QT-prolonging drugs in a patient regimen (ddi_flags ? 'QT_prolongation')
engine_capabilities_illustrative.hamer_phase_navigation: diseases in a given phase [phase-taxonomy use; conflict-theme FLAGGED]

honest_boundaries_verbatim: METACOD-слой выведен правилами по категории/классу/энергетике, не ручной экспертной разметкой — структурная аппроксимация для навигации; приоритетные случаи проверяются вручную.
Граф-связи статистические (по перекрытию симптомов/лаб), не причинно-следственные. Коморбидность и прогрессия — отдельные курируемые поля, пока минимальны.
Клинические поля шаблонные по категории — точные цифры требуют дозаполнения из источников.
Всё обогащение помечено version=3.0_enriched и флагами происхождения — выведенное легко отделимо от курируемого.
